assessment: The largest phylogeny of ribonucleotide reductases (RNRs) to-date is presented in this study via combining phylogenetic reconstruction, structural determination and analysis, and extensive discussion on the possible evolutionary history. A new clade of RNRs is uncovered and systematically compared with other well-known lineages of RNRs. Summarizing all observations and integrating previous knowledge, the authors propose a reasonable and not over-interpreted evolutionary model to depict the history of this ancient protein family. In sum, the arguments and data offered throughout this manuscript are strong and convincing, and they can help the community to comprehend the evolution of the diverse and crucial RNRs from a deep perspective.
